title: Terms of Service & Statutory Disclaimers — Maharashtra Scheme Navigator

statutory_role.disclaimer: Maharashtra Scheme Navigator is an informational and decision-support tool. It is NOT an official government benefits approval authority and does NOT guarantee scheme sanction.
statutory_role.final_authority: Sanction or rejection of applications rests exclusively with the competent statutory authority as notified under the Maharashtra Right to Services (RTS) Act, 2015.

acceptable_use: Users must provide accurate information to receive reliable scheme eligibility guidance.
Automated scraping, denial-of-service, or submitting malicious code/malware is strictly prohibited under the IT Act, 2000.
disclaimer_of_warranties: While eligibility rules are calibrated against official Government Resolutions (GRs), administrative guidelines may change without notice. Users are advised to verify latest notifications on Aaple Sarkar or Mantralaya portals.
governing_law: Laws of India and the jurisdiction of the High Court of Judicature at Bombay.
